author: Arnav
problem: Read N, X and the scores of the first N-1 rounds (each 0 to 100). The final grade is the sum of all N scores minus the highest and the lowest. Print the minimum score (0 to 100) needed in round N for a final grade of at least X, or -1 if no score works.
bug_description: Tries scores 0 to 99 only (range(0, 100)), so when 100 is the only score that works it prints -1.

comments.accurate: Tries every possible last-round score from 0 to 100 and prints the first that reaches X
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries last-round scores from 0 to 99 and prints the first that reaches X; a top score is dropped from the total anyway
comments.wrong_location: Score range verified; check the trimmed sum drops exactly one highest and one lowest score
